invariants.text: Contact.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
When a contact is imported from CSV, any row with invalid data (such as missing required fields or malformed values) must be rejected and not added to the database.
The export to CSV command must include all contact fields: first_name, last_name, email, phone, and address.
The import from CSV command must validate that each row contains at least the required fields: first_name, last_name, email, and phone.
If an email address is provided in a contact row, it must be in a valid format (e.g., contain an '@' symbol and a domain).
When a contact is created or updated, the updated_at timestamp must be set to the current time.
The created_at timestamp for a new contact must be set to the current time.
If a contact with the same email address already exists, the import operation must reject the new contact and not allow duplicates.
The import operation must not modify existing contacts in the database; only new valid contacts are added.
All operations must maintain data integrity and ensure that no existing data is corrupted during import or export.
